protocol: Physical horizontal image offset; position standoff 0.50 m; final error norm <=5 px for 300 ms. Initial offset preparation at gain 0.5. Per-run recovery gain stated separately. Host timestamp proxies.
limitations: Single trial per setting, varying initial pose and measurement noise.
P=2.0 only tested at about 24 px; do not extrapolate to larger offsets.
Offsets >60 px use an explicit 0.20 rad/s reference norm cap and kinematic corridor checks.
No independent target or motion-capture truth; arrival times are not calibrated capture timestamps.
300 px request aborted after cross-track displacement reached about 20.8 mm; workspace corridor limit 20 mm.
View boundary was not reached; no 400 px test was performed.
final_state: Low-speed recentering completed, tracking stopped, independent video preview running.
